description: HTTP contract of every tingqr framework integration that serves a QR code as an SVG image (TypeScript: @tingqr/hono, @tingqr/nestjs; .NET: TingQR.AspNetCore). The app decides the payload (a resolve callback or a handler); no integration ever builds a QR from URL or query parameters.

success.when: the app gives a non-empty QR payload that renders

empty.when: the app gives null, undefined/absent or an empty string
empty.body: not fixed (framework default); never an image

tingQrError.when: the app throws a TingQrError, or the payload or an option cannot be rendered
tingQrError.note: Integrations whose framework routes errors through app filters (NestJS) guarantee the status and error.code only when the app does not rewrite the body.

otherErrors: left to the framework's normal error handling, unchanged

logo.rule: a logo href must start with data:image/ (an SVG shown as an image cannot load a path or URL); anything else is INVALID_VALUE when the route or service is configured, not per request

notInContract: the status for a handler result that is not a string (a programming error)
